meanings.usage: 描述动作进行的速度快
统一规格的服装，常指军服或工作服
指光亮强烈地照射或燃烧
指从束缚或危险中逃离
军队中有军衔的人或政府官员
军队中下级对上级表示敬意的动作
形容刀刃锋利或动作突然有力
描述无所畏惧地做某事
stand to attention表示立正姿势

examples.en: He dragged the box into the room.
She changed into her sports clothes.
The soldier marched up and down in front of the gate.
The soldiers stood to attention when the officer passed.
examples.zh: 当军官经过时，士兵们立正敬礼。

examples.en: A stranger came towards me on the street.
examples.zh: 街上一个陌生人向我走来。

examples.en: He knocked the man to the ground with one punch.
examples.zh: 他一拳把那人打倒在地。

examples.en: The thief drove off at high speed.
They couldn't see anything in the darkness.
examples.zh: 他们在黑暗中什么都看不见。

phrases.phrase: with a rifle over his shoulder

examples.en: He stood there with a bag over his shoulder.
examples.zh: 他肩上背着包站在那里。

examples.en: He jumped into the car and drove away.

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词 + (before + 过去时态)...
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作或状态，由had + 过去分词构成 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时。常与when, after, before等连词连用。

examples.en: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner dragged him into the bushes.
examples.zh: 当他杀死卫兵后，囚犯把他拖进了灌木丛。

examples.en: When they had gone, the driver came towards him.
examples.zh: 他们走后，司机向他走来。

grammar.title: 过去进行时与一般过去时的对比
grammar.structure: was/were + doing (过去进行时) vs. did (一般过去时)
grammar.definition: 过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作，一般过去时表示过去已完成的动作 当一个长时间动作正在进行时，另一个短动作发生，此时用过去进行时+when+一般过去时

examples.en: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there.
examples.zh: 灯光明亮，人们四处奔跑。

examples.en: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention.
examples.zh: 军官们下车了，囚犯立正敬礼。

grammar.title: with复合结构
grammar.structure: with + 名词/代词 + 介词短语/形容词/副词/分词
grammar.definition: with + 宾语 + 介词短语/形容词/副词/分词，表示附带状态或伴随情况 用于描述事物的状态、穿着、携带物品等，可作状语或定语

examples.en: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulder, the prisoner marched boldly.
examples.zh: 现在，穿着蓝色制服，肩上扛着步枪，囚犯大胆地来回走动。

examples.en: The man was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
examples.zh: 这人年纪较大，满头白发，碧蓝的眼睛。

patterns.pattern: When + 主语 + had + 过去分词..., 主语 + 过去时态...

original.en: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner quickly dragged him into the bushes.
original.zh: 当他杀死卫兵后，囚犯迅速把他拖进了灌木丛。

imitations.zh: 当我完成作业后，我就去睡觉了。

imitations.en: When she had cooked dinner, she called the family.
imitations.zh: 她做完饭后，叫家人吃饭。

patterns.pattern: ...with + 名词 + 介词短语/形容词...

original.en: He was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
original.zh: 这人年纪较大，满头白发，碧蓝的眼睛。

imitations.en: The girl stood there with a red flower in her hand.
imitations.zh: 女孩手里拿着一朵红花站在那里。

imitations.en: He came in with his head down.

original.en: The man obviously wanted to talk.

imitations.en: She wanted to buy a new car.
They wanted to travel around the world.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词 + off + as + 形容词/副词比较级 + as + 主语 + could

original.zh: 他尽可能快地开车离开了。

imitations.en: She ran away as fast as she could.
He finished the work as soon as he could.

lines.en: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.
lines.zh: 那个战俘杀死卫兵以后，迅速地把尸体拖进了灌木丛。

lines.en: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
lines.zh: 他在黑暗中忙活了一阵儿，很快就换上了死者的衣服。

lines.en: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulder, the prisoner marched boldly up and down in front of the camp.
lines.zh: 现在他身穿蓝军装，肩扛步枪，在军营门前大胆地来回走看。

lines.en: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
lines.zh: 他听得军营里面的喧闹声。

lines.en: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there: they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
lines.zh: 那里灯火通明，人们在东奔西跑：他们刚刚发现有一个俘虏跑了。

lines.en: At that moment, a large black car with four officers inside it, stopped at the camp gates.
lines.zh: 正在此时，一辆黑色大轿车在军营门口停了下来。

lines.en: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
When they had gone, the driver of the car came towards him.
lines.zh: 军官们下了车，战俘立正站好，并在他们从他面前经过时敬了礼。

lines.en: The man obviously wanted to talk.
lines.zh: 他们走后，汽车司机向他走来，这人显然是想聊天。

lines.en: He was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
lines.zh: 他上了年纪，有着灰白的头发和明亮的蓝眼睛。

lines.en: The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do.
lines.zh: 战俘为他感到惋惜，但却没有别的选择。

lines.en: As the man came near, the prisoner knocked him to the ground with a sharp blow. Then, jumping into the car, he drove off as quickly as he could.
lines.zh: 当这个人走近时，战俘一拳把他打倒在地，然后跳进车里，以最快的速度把车开走了。

questions.q: Why did the prisoner attack the driver?
questions.a: Because he needed the car to escape. The driver had come close to him, and although the prisoner felt sorry for him, there was nothing else he could do.
questions.aZh: 因为他需要这辆车逃走。司机走到了他跟前，尽管战俘为他感到惋惜，却别无选择。
questions.hint: 见课文最后两句：The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do. / he drove off as quickly as he could.

questions.q: What did the prisoner do as soon as he had killed the guard?
questions.zh: 战俘杀死卫兵后立刻做了什么？
questions.a: He quickly dragged the body into the bushes, and working rapidly in the darkness he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
questions.aZh: 他迅速把尸体拖进灌木丛，并在黑暗中忙活一阵，很快换上了死者的衣服。
questions.hint: 见课文第 1、2 句中的 dragged him into the bushes 与 changed into the dead man's clothes。

questions.q: What was happening inside the camp?
questions.zh: 当时军营里是什么情形？
questions.a: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there, because they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
questions.aZh: 那里灯火通明，人们东奔西跑，因为他们刚刚发现有个俘虏逃跑了。
questions.hint: 见 Lights were blazing and men were running here and there: they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.

questions.q: What did the prisoner do when the officers got out of the car?
questions.zh: 军官们下车时战俘做了什么？
questions.a: He stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
questions.aZh: 他立正站好，并在他们从他面前经过时敬了礼。
questions.hint: 见 the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed。

questions.q: The prisoner felt sorry for the elderly driver, yet he still knocked him down. How do you understand this?
questions.zh: 战俘为这位上了年纪的司机感到惋惜，却仍把他打倒在地。你如何理解他这种矛盾的心理？
questions.a: He was not cruel by nature, but his own freedom was at stake. He pitied the old man, yet the car was his only way out, so he had no real choice.
questions.aZh: 他本性并不残忍，只是自己的自由危在旦夕。他同情这位老人，可这辆车是他唯一的出路，所以他实在没有别的选择。
questions.hint: 结合 The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do. 与结尾情节进行推理。

translation:
那个战俘杀死卫兵以后，迅速地把尸体拖进了灌木丛。
他在黑暗中忙活了一阵儿，很快就换上了死者的衣服。
现在他身穿蓝军装，肩扛步枪，在军营门前大胆地来回走看。
他听得军营里面的喧闹声。
那里灯火通明，人们在东奔西跑：他们刚刚发现有一个俘虏跑了。
正在此时，一辆黑色大轿车在军营门口停了下来。
里面坐了4个军官。
军官们下了车，战俘立正站好，并在他们从他面前经过时敬了礼。
他们走后，汽车司机向他走来，这人显然是想聊天。
他上了年纪，有着灰白的头发和明亮的蓝眼睛。
战俘为他感到惋惜，但却没有别的选择。
当这个人走近时，战俘一拳把他打倒在地，然后跳进车里，以最快的速度把车开走了。
title: Escape
subtitle: 脱逃

lead.question: 一名战俘乔装成卫兵逃出军营，为什么最后又打倒了汽车司机？
lead.warmup: 本课讲一个战俘越狱脱逃的故事。他杀死卫兵，把尸体拖进灌木丛，换上死者的蓝军装，肩扛步枪在营门口大胆地来回走动。营内灯火通明、人声嘈杂，人们刚发现有人逃跑。一辆载着四名军官的黑车停在门口。战俘趁机打倒走下车的司机，夺车逃去。
goals: 能认读并拼写 bush / uniform / rifle / shoulder / march / blaze / bold / salute 等本课核心词汇。
能正确使用 change into、up and down、here and there、stand at/to attention 等固定短语。
能理解并运用 It is not long before ... 句型表达“不久就……”。
能复述战俘脱逃的完整经过，并说明他为何袭击好心的司机。
lead.summary: 一名战俘杀死卫兵后把尸体拖进灌木丛，换上死者的蓝军装，肩扛步枪在营门口大胆巡视。营内灯火通明，人们四处奔跑，刚发现有人逃跑。一辆载有四名军官的黑色轿车停在营门口，战俘立正敬礼目送他们离去。司机随后走近想攀谈，战俘别无选择，一拳将他打倒在地，跳上车飞速逃走。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：clothes 指衣服，永远用复数，如 the dead man's clothes；cloth 指布料，多不可数，别混用。

exercises.q: 汉译英：士兵们肩并肩地站着，随时准备战斗。
exercises.a: The soldiers stood shoulder to shoulder, ready to fight. / The soldiers stood shoulder to shoulder and were prepared to fight.
exercises.note: shoulder to shoulder；be prepared to do

exercises.q: 用适当介词填空：The prisoner was dressed ___ a blue uniform, with a rifle ___ his shoulder.
exercises.note: dressed in；a rifle over one's shoulder

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 It is not long before ... 改写句子：The camp was quiet. Then the men discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
exercises.a: It was not long before the men discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
exercises.note: It is/was not long before + 从句

exercises.q: 改错：The prisoner changed into the dead man's cloth and marched bold up and down.
exercises.a: 错误两处：cloth 改为 clothes；bold 改为 boldly。
exercises.note: cloth 是布料；修饰动词用副词

exercises.q: 用 prison 的适当形式填空：The ___ of war killed the guard, but he was soon caught and put in ___ again.
汉译英：那段时间他一直躲在灌木丛里。
exercises.a: He was hiding in the bushes the whole time.

exercises.q: 用括号中动词的适当形式填空：Lights ___ (blaze) and men were running here and there.

options: bush
brush
bunch
bushy
with a rifle over his shoulder
with a rifle at his shoulder
with a rifle in his shoulder
with a rifle below his shoulder

quiz.q: 下列哪句正确表达“不久他们就发现有个俘虏逃跑了”？
options: It was not long before they discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
It was not long when they discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
It was not long that they discovered a prisoner had escaped.
It was long before they discovered a prisoner had escaped.
quiz.note: It is/was not long before + 从句

quiz.q: The officers got out and the prisoner stood ___ attention and saluted.
options: at
in
on
by

quiz.q: 下列哪句与课文一致、用法正确？
options: He soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
He soon changed into the dead man's cloth.
He soon changed into the dead man's clothe.
He soon changed into the dead man's cloths.

quiz.q: The prisoner knocked the driver to the ground with a sharp ___.
options: blow
blew
blowing
blown
quiz.note: blow 名词：一击；blew 是过去式
